definitions.explanation: The process of gradual change and development through history.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変遷|へんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}する→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧。
examples.english: To research the evolution of language.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変遷|へんせん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ともに→ともに：03468_tomoni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: It changed with the passage of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変遷|へんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たどる→たどる：10366_tadoru⟧。
examples.english: To trace the changes through history.

notes:
{変遷|へんせん} refers to gradual change and evolution over time, typically used when discussing historical or social developments.

FORMS:
{変|へん} (change) + {遷|せん} (shift/move) = transition over time

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変遷|へんせん}: changes through the ages
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変遷|へんせん}: historical transitions
- {変遷|へんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たどる→たどる：10366_tadoru⟧: to trace changes/evolution
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変遷|へんせん}: evolution of language
- {変遷|へんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}る→経る：13876_heru⟧: to go through changes

TYPICAL SUBJECTS:
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変遷|へんせん}: social changes
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変遷|へんせん}: cultural evolution
- ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変遷|へんせん}: institutional changes

REGISTER:
Formal/academic. Common in scholarly writing and historical discussions.
